testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel the save prompt after leaving sketch editing to close: tmp/obk-tabs2/features/application/document-tabs/document-tabs.feature:106:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel the save prompt after leaving sketch editing to close ✔ Given a new part contains an unsaved sketch in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user is editing that sketch ✔ And the environment-exit message is enabled ✔ When the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab ✔ And the user chooses OK to exit the sketch environment and continue ✔ Then a save-changes prompt identifies the part ✔ And the prompt offers Yes, No and cancels ✔ When the user chooses Cancel at the save-changes prompt ✔ Then the part remains open ✔ And its sketch remains listed in the model browser ✔ And the part modeling environment is active
